documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Considering Unaudited Financial Results For Quarter And Half-Year Ended 30Th September, 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Somany Ceramics reported moderate sales growth for Q1 FY27, impacted by a 1.5-month shutdown in Morbi during April. Despite this, EBITDA margins expanded to 11.6% due to improved capacity utilization and a turnaround in joint ventures from losses to profits. Management is bullish on the future, announcing a new 9+ million square meter plant in the South and various balancing equipment additions. The company expects mid-single-digit volume growth for the year and aims to maintain or better its current margin levels. Somany Ceramics reported a strong performance in Q1 FY27, with consolidated revenue growing 24% year-on-year to INR 744 crore and EBITDA margin improving to 11.6%.

guidance.claim: Management maintains that the EBITDA margins delivered in the current quarter will be sustained and improved.
guidance.quote: And we maintain that the EBITDA margins delivered in this quarter would be maintained, and we are trying to better our EBITDA margins, which we have delivered in last quarter and on this quarter.

guidance.claim: The new South plant will provide potential revenue of about INR350 crores upon completion.
guidance.quote: This would give us a potential revenue of about INR350 crores.

guidance.claim: The company guides to improve EBITDA margin by at least 1.5% or more from the current base.
guidance.quote: our guidance is to improve EBITDA margin from here by at least 1.5% or more.

guidance.claim: Management targets very decent single-digit volume growth for the tile business.
guidance.quote: volume will be in a single -- very decent single digits for the tile business.

guidance.claim: The sanitaryware and adhesive business is expected to grow in very healthy double digits.
guidance.quote: For the sanitaryware and adhesive business would be in very healthy double digits.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in May and June was pretty decent, and July has been acceptable despite rains.
demand_outlook.quote: Other than that, the demand of May and June has been pretty decent. July also has been not bad considering that there's been rains in many parts of the country.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall, management is extremely bullish regarding the future outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, we are extremely bullish of the future outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about the industry's growth prospects driven by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the industry’s growth prospects, supported by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.

demand_outlook.claim: March was an aberration month because of geopolitical circumstances.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, March was a very aberration month because of the various circumstances which played out geopolitically.

demand_outlook.claim: Current demand is slow as consumers take time to absorb price increases.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand is weak currently. Like I mentioned earlier in the call that people are waiting. General sentiments are down, plus the labor is not there for putting the tiles. Therefore, we believe that the demand will come in as a pent-up demand like we had after COVID.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced setting up a 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, ready in 12 to 15 months.
capex_expansion.quote: Because of that, we have announced setting up a 9 million square meter plant -- 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which would be up and ready by in the next 12 to 15 months.

capex_expansion.claim: The outlay for the South plant project is approximately INR220 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, the major capex plan is the 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which is approximately INR220 crores outlay, which is for next year.

capex_expansion.claim: Additional capacity of 4 million to 5 million square meters will be added through existing lines in Bahadurgarh, Gujarat, Morbi, and the South.
capex_expansion.quote: Other than that, we are taking many more steps, which are all work in progress to augment further capacity by about 4 million to 5 million in our existing lines in Bahadurgarh in -- which is in Haryana and in Gujarat and in Morbi and also in the South.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capital outlay from now until the end of FY27 is approximately INR275 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So from now to '27 end, we have already looked at approximately INR275 crores outlay, which includes the INR220 crores plant plus balancing equipment in various other plants and some more balancing equipment in the Bathware, sanitaryware plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced a new manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million plus square meters of Glazed Vitrified Tiles to cater to the growing Southern market.
capex_expansion.quote: To cater to the growing Southern market, the Company has announced a new manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million+ sqm. of Glazed Vitrified Tiles.

capex_expansion.claim: An investment of INR30 crores was made in the Somany Max plant to improve utilization levels.
capex_expansion.quote: We put in an investment of INR30 crores to make the utilization level better in Somany Max by putting the press.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex will be contained within INR70 crores to INR80 crores for routine capex and balancing equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: So everything will be contained in the INR70 crores, INR80 crores of routine capex and balancing equipment to make our assets more value-added or more -- towards more capacity utilization.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter increased by 3.6% to 11.6% due to operational efficiencies and capacity utilization.
margins_costs.quote: So EBITDA margins go up by 3.6% to 11.6% for the quarter. Capacity utilization in the JVs and very, very significantly in our own plants have gone up.

margins_costs.claim: The company successfully passed on gas price increases ranging between 16% and 18%.
margins_costs.quote: Fortunately, we've been able to pass on all the gas price increase until now. So the current price increase has been between 16% and 18%.

margins_costs.claim: The blended natural gas price is about INR68 in the North.
margins_costs.quote: And in the North, it is slightly lower, which is around the INR68, INR69 level. This is for natural gas.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 11.6% driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 11.6%, driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA improved significantly by 3.2% in Q4 and about 1% for the entire year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA improved quite significantly, 3.2% in Q4 and about 1% in the entire year.

margins_costs.claim: Gas prices increased very significantly following the war.
margins_costs.quote: Gas price, as you all know, has increased very significantly, which we can talk about that.

margins_costs.claim: Input cost increases have been passed on entirely in retail and about 85% in projects.
margins_costs.quote: Input cost increase currently has been passed on to an extent, and we can talk about that in the Q&A.

margins_costs.claim: Brand spend was about 2% for the year.
margins_costs.quote: As far as our business is concerned, our brand spend has been about 2% for the year.

orders_capacity.quote: Morbi operations have completely started. They have resumed 100% production on very expensive gas

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization was largely flat, moving from approximately 80% to 79% for the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization was largely flat from approximately 80% to 79%. So that is largely flat.

orders_capacity.claim: Tiles volume increased GVT sales by 3%, with a corresponding reduction in ceramic and PVT by 3%.
orders_capacity.quote: If you see the tiles volume, we have increased our GVT sales by 3%, and there's been a reduction in the ceramic and PVT by 3% correspondingly.

orders_capacity.claim: Sanitaryware grew by 8% for the entire year, closing at INR320 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Sanitaryware has done fairly well. We've grown by 8% for the entire year, and we have closed the figure at INR320 crores, up from INR296 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Net dealer additions were 200 dealers across India, taking the total dealer showrooms to about 3,100.
orders_capacity.quote: The net dealer addition has been very strong this year. We've added net new additions of 200 dealers across India, taking the total dealer showrooms to about 3,100.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital days came down from 17 to 12 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital days also have come down from 17 to 12 days.

capital_allocation.claim: Approximately 60% to 65%-70% of the capex will be funded through internal accruals.
Working capital improved, becoming marginally lower by 4 days to 9 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital, we've done fairly well. It's marginally lower by 4 days to 9 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The company cannot do a share buyback for the next 6 to 8 months due to an embargo from SEBI while consolidating wholly owned subsidiaries.
capital_allocation.quote: Unfortunately, we are consolidating some of our JV -- sorry, our wholly owned subs, and therefore, there is an embargo on -- from SEBI. We can't do a share buyback for the next 6, 8 months.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exports from Morbi are down by 50% to 60% from the peak due to geopolitical reasons.
risks_headwinds.quote: The only negative in the quarter has been from a Morbi perspective is exports has been down due to geopolitical reasons, the export is down a good 50%, 60% from the peak.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices, resulting in production curtailments across the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exports were affected in March because nothing sailed or went out during the outage.
risks_headwinds.quote: Overall, if you see the exports did increase from last year. It would have touched about INR18,000 crores, but -- for the industry, but it got stopped at 17 and something because -- INR17,000-and-something crores because of the March outage, where nothing really went or sailed in March.

risks_headwinds.claim: Morbi plants are facing a major labor shortage.
risks_headwinds.quote: The situation currently in Morbi is that whoever has started up is facing a little bit of challenge with labor. There a major, major, major labor shortage in Morbi.

management_commitments.claim: The 9 million square meter plant in the South will be up and ready in the next 12 to 15 months.
management_commitments.quote: Because of that, we have announced setting up a 9 million square meter plant -- 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which would be up and ready by in the next 12 to 15 months.

management_commitments.claim: Capacity additions across existing lines will be ready from mid-quarter 3 and completely in place in quarter 4.
management_commitments.quote: All put together, we will be adding another 4 million to 5 million for the mid -- this will be ready from mid-quarter 3 and would be completely in place in quarter 4.

management_commitments.claim: The new plant in the South will be operational by the end of quarter 3 or beginning of quarter 4 next year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, end of quarter 3, beginning quarter 4 of next year, it will be operational.

management_commitments.claim: Debottlenecking and balancing equipment additions will be concluded by the end of quarter 3.
management_commitments.quote: That is happening now, which -- most of which will be concluded by end of quarter 3.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that its focus will remain on delivering profitable growth through market share gains, product premiumization, higher capacity utilization, disciplined cost management, and stronger cash flow generation.
management_commitments.quote: Our focus will remain on delivering profitable growth through market share gains, product premiumization, higher capacity utilization, disciplined cost management, and stronger cash flow generation.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue to leverage its strong brand equity and extensive distribution network to capitalize on emerging market opportunities.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue to leverage our strong brand equity and extensive distribution network to capitalize on emerging market opportunities.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to improve EBITDA margin by at least 1.5% or more.
management_commitments.quote: our guidance is to improve EBITDA margin from here by at least 1.5% or more.

management_commitments.claim: Management has taken a very aggressive double-digit target for sanitaryware.
management_commitments.quote: And this year, we've taken a very aggressive target, a very aggressive double-digit target.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
